mainEntity.name: Can EarlyJobs help recruit food processing workers?

acceptedAnswer.text: EarlyJobs helps food and FMCG plant employers assess production, packaging, quality support and warehouse hiring. Share hygiene protocols, line speeds and seasonal peaks so candidates understand shop-floor expectations.

Yes. Employers should specify contract length, volume spikes around festivals or harvest windows, and joining dates. EarlyJobs uses that context to plan sourcing without over-promising permanent headcount.

mainEntity.name: Are freshers eligible for food manufacturing roles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some entry-level packaging and material-handling roles may consider freshers when employers provide hygiene induction and PPE training. Production stations with allergen or temperature controls may need additional criteria.

Employers remain responsible for FSSAI-aligned hygiene training, hair-net and glove discipline, and documented GMP practices on the line. EarlyJobs supports hiring coordination—not regulatory sign-off.
